test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

FLUKE
solution:
​The correct answer is '**Chance**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Fluke**' is '**Chance**'.
 
• **Fluke**: a surprising and lucky result that happens by accident, not because you have been clever or skilful. [आश्‍चर्यजनक और सुखद संयोग से प्राप्‍त परिणाम (न कि कौशलपूर्वक अर्जित)]
 
 
• *Example: This will remove **fluke** burdens and reduce contamination of pastures with fluke eggs.*
 
 
 
• **Chance**: a possibility. (संभावना)
 
 
• *Example: I think we stand a good **chance** of winning the competition.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Chance.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:

 
 
• **Policy**: a plan of action agreed upon or chosen by a government, a company, etc. [सरकार, कंपनी आदि की नीति, कार्य-योजना]
 
• **Plan**: an idea or arrangement for doing or achieving something in the future. [योजना, विचार (किसी काम या कुछ करने के लिए)]
 
• **Contract**: a written legal agreement. (इक़रारनामा, अनुबंध-पत्र)
